correctness.rationale: The necessity obstruction is local and exhaustive: an unselected center with two unselected private leaves can never reduce to a unique unobserved neighbor. Under the complementary side conditions, every center is observed in the domination step and each side has at most one leaf left to force. This proves the exact iff classification, after which coefficient multiplication is literal. Exhaustive direct simulation on thirty-six parameter pairs verifies the classification and every coefficient.
